tool gives a training NMSE of 7.6e-24, well below the 1e-12 target.

I found it in two steps. A basis of {1/A, 1, A, A², A³} fits the data to about 1e-11, and the time terms I added contributed nothing. The constants are 2.36 (on 1/A) and −0.149 (on A³), and both are rounded in the tool's printout.
